scope: One fixed case02 frozen-operator helper compile/link. No MSBuild, installation, help, helper execution, solver, time integration or automatic follow-up. Existing generic helper_build_r2 and all receipts remain unchanged.
fixed_author: support/upl_case02_operator_r1.cpp and notes/upl_case02_operator_r1.json; capture actual final bytes/SHA at invocation before any build-tool call, then rehash. No speculative or pre-author hash is embedded.
authorization: Root must fully review both final operator files and this recipe/note before each explicit invocation. Neither configuration is started by authoring. Planned order is separately authorized DebugCPU compile plus smoke review, then separately authorized ReleaseCPU compile/matrix; this build recipe starts no smoke/matrix and does not automatically chain configurations.
reused_pattern: Minimal fixed-author adaptation of the actually successful upl_case02_helper_build_r2.ps1. It reuses the same current-build records and actual successful matching wall r2 compiler/link/environment recipes without modifying or invoking that script.

current_builds.closure: Both actual passed isolated x64 CPU builds have86 compile sources/objects,265 current/original-snapshot code pairs and seven protected canonical programs. Use matching configuration only; no production rebuild or source/snapshot copy. Exclude main.obj and substitute all85 non-main objects by exact unique basename membership in the old link vector. Link only these85 plus the new helper.obj.

recorded_recipes.policy: Require actual typed exit0 compile/link calls, passed r2 recipe, sealed matching environment_source and five nonempty selected environment values. Only actual cl/link argument shape, tools,17 recorded libraries and four runtime-copy identities are inherited; historical wall source/objects are not current-source acceptance. Debug wall r1 is not used or reclassified.

compile_link.compile: Remap exactly source,/Fo,/Fd and sourceDependencies destination. Preserve /std:c++17,/fp:precise and /MTd or /MT. Complete filenames are individual native arguments, avoiding manually quoted trailing-backslash directories.
compile_link.include: Only local support include upl_cpu_public_native_r1.cpp 22469B SHA9f6668bfe3d1bbcca7c45c58809f7062c21fcb46baae76f0a2a1b0ef3ca56d38. Capture its note too; actual compiler dependency JSON must name the operator source and exactly this support include.
compile_link.link: Replace all85 old non-main object paths by current same-basename objects; reject duplicate/unknown/main entries. Replace one helper object and OUT, plus the existing Debug-only PDB. Actual Release recipe has no PDB option. Exactly86 object arguments are required before link.
compile_link.ownership: Fresh stdout and owned call receipt per direct cl/link; reset LASTEXITCODE and capture its actual typed value immediately. Failure skips subsequent stages, retains partial artifacts and writes a failed helper receipt when the owned call returns normally. Preflight failure starts no build tool.
compile_link.hashes: Before compile, before link and after the attempt, verify author files,265 current/snapshot pairs plus membership,86 compile-source/object identities, actual build/recipe/environment/call/tool/library records, seven canonical programs and retained/current runtime. Final binding status is recorded independently of compiler success. This bounded closure is not a claim of fully pinned OS/SDK/CRT reproducibility.

runtime: After successful link copy DsphConfig.xml,ChronoEngine.dll,dsphchrono.dll,vcomp140.dll from four sealed successful same-configuration helper copies, after verifying each equals current bin/windows same-name bytes/SHA. Rehash copies and originals; never replace canonical files.

fresh_outputs.records: logs/upl_case02_operator_{Configuration}_r1.helper.json and _Compile.log/.call.json,_Link.log/.call.json; helper.obj,PDBs and compile.dependencies.json remain inside the fresh output directory.
fresh_outputs.retention: Each configuration has independent fresh names. Reject existing outputs/logs/receipt; never overwrite old failed/successful build, operator, export or solver evidence.

limits: A future compile/link pass proves only that this fixed helper linked against the recorded current objects. It does not prove frozen-matrix correctness, stability, completed coarse/half acceptance, default-OFF/GPU/Cryer support or physical accuracy. Runtime calls require separate root authorization.
